item.title: Review a Coat Repair Service
item.audience: people choosing a clothes repair shop
item.prompt_text: A repair shop fixed a loose pocket on your winter coat. You paid $12 and collected the coat two days later. The repair is neat, but the shop did not send the pickup message it promised. Write a useful review. Describe the job, discuss both parts of the experience, and recommend the service to a specific kind of customer.
item.target_grammar: Past simple for the visit; although and however for a balanced review; would for a recommendation.
item.target_structure: Introduce the job and cost, describe the result and pickup issue, and give a qualified recommendation.

checklist.point: Say what the shop repaired and give a practical detail such as price or time.
Describe the quality of the repair.
Explain what happened with the pickup message.
Recommend the shop to a particular kind of customer.
